mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_notification (notification_type, severity, title, message, reference_type, reference_id, dedupe_key) VALUES ('BATCH_FAILURE', 'CRITICAL', #{title}, #{message}, 'BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION', #{jobExecutionId}, #{dedupeKey}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE occurrence_count = occurrence_count + 1, last_occurred_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, title = VALUES (title), message = VALUES (message), reference_id = VALUES (reference_id), status = 'OPEN', resolved_by = NULL, resolved_at = NULL
